dat_structure_validation_with_xenomodkit.notes: Main/Lang were decoded with the exact codec family used by the mod; legacy CacheData was decoded with the legacy CacheData algorithm used by FHD_UpgradeUnknovn. The decoded BlockPar trees were then validated by XenoModKit 0.10.4. Direct DAT audit through BlockParEditor 2.1 cannot run in this Linux environment because XenoModKit's Windows executable/version/legacy-manifest path is Windows-only.

result: No functional ART_COMPAT defect found by XenoModKit 0.10.4 static/native/decoded-BlockPar validation. Remaining real findings are font-glyph warnings only. Full official DAT CLI validation still requires running XenoModKit 0.10.4 + BlockParEditor 2.1 on Windows.
